name: logknobs
description: logknobs — configurator for git log pretty-format templates. Browser + Electron, byte-verified against real git.

scripts.test:registry: T=$(mktemp) && python3 ../probe/scripts/build_registry.py ../probe/evidence $T ../research | tail -1 && cmp $T ../probe/evidence/registry-v0.3.0.json && echo "registry: regenerated byte-identical"
scripts.verify: npm run -s build && npm run -s setup && npm run -s test:registry && npm run -s test:oracle-a && npm run -s test:quoting && npm run -s test:t8 && npm run -s test:t10 && npm run -s test:t11 && npm run -s test:t12 && npm run -s test:t13 && npm run -s test:t14 && npm run -s test:oracle-b && npm run -s test:realgit

comment:versions: Versions are pinned exactly, not caret-ranged. The corpus in evidence/ is
bound to git 2.43.0, and Oracle B compares screenshots -- a floating
Chromium or Playwright version silently invalidates reference images.
Bumping electron or @playwright/test requires regenerating Oracle B
comment:no-runtime-deps: There are no runtime dependencies by design. The browser build is a
single self-contained bundle; the simulator, the span-tree renderer and
the ANSI renderer are all first-party because each is a differential
correctness surface that must not drift with a third-party release.
comment:deps: vitest and typescript removed in 0.4.0: vitest@5.0.0 crashes npm's
peer resolver (isolated by single-package install) and neither was used by
any gate. Every gate runs under plain node + playwright/electron.
comment:timeouts: every Electron gate runs under timeout(1), and every CI job and step has timeout-minutes: a hung run fails instead of running forever
